config.file:
<catalog>
declare variable $content as node() external;
for $product in $content//article[@class="product_pod"] return <product> <title>{normalize-space($product//h3/a/@title)}</title> <price>{normalize-space($product//p[@class="price_color"])}</price> <rating>{normalize-space($product//p[@class="star-rating"]/@class)}</rating> <availability>{normalize-space($product//p[@class="instock availability"])}</availability> </product>
</catalog>
